title: Canonical content entry frontmatter
description: Frontmatter required on every file in content/. Type-specific fields (race, alignment, rarity, cr, ...) are allowed as extra top-level keys in snake_case.

id.description: Stable identifier '<type>/<slug>'. Never reuse or rename without adding the old id to 'aliases'.

summary.description: One sentence, plain text. Used by consumers for previews/search.

setting.description: World/setting this belongs to, if not the default world.

status.description: canonical = reviewed; draft = promoted but incomplete; needs-review = open conflict in review/conflicts.md; deprecated = superseded (keep for old ids).

path.description: path of the raw file, relative to raw/<source>/

hash.description: content_hash of the raw file when it was last merged
